scope: Outcome-focused review of already generated automatic replies, not supplied-goal compliance. Exploratory assistant judgments on16 constructed development conversations; no independent human quality score.
criterion: Any sensible context-compatible acceptance, refusal, counterproposal or clarification is allowed regardless of predicted act agreement or reference wording. Factual contradictions, role reversals and unsupported certainty remain failures.

conclusion: Mixed wins and losses; no reliable overall automatic-reply upgrade established. This conclusion does not depend on exact reply-act compliance.
prior_work: Context-contrast expansion, adapter-capacity changes, STANDARD emphasis, full fine-tuning and validation early stopping have already been tried. Do not present another generic more-data/more-epochs intervention as new.
next_investigation: Audit grounding failures in current starting checkpoint and original/expanded targets before another training intervention. Keep natural-English generator adequacy separate from meaning-preserving LOCAL rewriting. Define success by automatic reply usefulness, not labels.
